name: MotionProvider
purpose: Provide shared Motion features and user-level reduced-motion configuration.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; rendered verification pending.

name: SiteHeader
purpose: Orient visitors around the kingXford & Co mission and expose global routes, theme control, and command navigation.
content_contract: Brand link; Mission, R&D / Lab, Work, Media, About, and Contact routes; ThemeControls; CommandPalette.
states: top; scrolled; mobile menu closed; mobile menu open; focus-within
keyboard_behavior: Tab reaches brand, navigation, theme options, command trigger, and mobile disclosure in logical order; native summary toggles menu.
accessible_name: Primary navigation; mobile navigation; kingXford & Co home link and identity.
focus_behavior: Visible focus inherited from global focus token; no focus trapping in navigation.
responsive_behavior: Desktop links become a native disclosure menu at compact widths; controls remain reachable.
localization_behavior: Short English labels; structure permits text expansion without icon-only route labels.
data_dependencies: Route inventory; CommandPalette; ThemeControls; KingxfordLogo; window scroll state; current route.
test_coverage: Source inspection after mission and Media integration complete; keyboard walkthrough pending.
notes: Mobile copy foregrounds intelligence, R&D, responsible AI, and sustainable abundance; route changes close the mobile disclosure.

name: SiteFooter
purpose: Close the narrative with the kingXford & Co mission, company-safe navigation, craft signature, and collaboration route.
content_contract: Exact brand name; intelligence, R&D, responsible AI, and sustainable-abundance statement; Mission, R&D / Lab, Work, Media, About, and Contact routes; current year.
keyboard_behavior: All links are native anchors or Next links in document order.
accessible_name: Footer navigation and kingXford & Co home identity are explicit.
focus_behavior: Visible focus inherited from global focus token.
responsive_behavior: Columns stack on compact screens and expand at medium widths.
localization_behavior: Compact English copy; no personal profile, location, or private contact data.
data_dependencies: Public route inventory and company-safe content only.
test_coverage: Source inspection after mission and privacy integration complete; link verification pending.
notes: No personal GitHub profile or personal location is exposed; operational repository identity remains outside the rendered footer.

name: KingxfordLogo
purpose: Render the restrained kingXford & Co primary wordmark and compact framed K monogram.
content_contract: Optional className, decorative flag, exact brand name, same-scale colour-emphasized X, monochrome option, compact K mark, and & Co suffix.
variants: wordmark; compact K mark; monochrome; informative; decorative
accessible_name: Default label: kingXford & Co; decorative mode hides the mark and lockup.
responsive_behavior: Scales with its containing block; the X stays on the same baseline and at the same optical size as surrounding letters; & Co remains subordinate.
localization_behavior: Accessible label can be localized by caller.
data_dependencies: No runtime data; SVG and typeset identity only.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; small-size, monochrome, dark/light, and rendered wordmark verification pending.
notes: The compact icon is a framed K with one restrained ultramarine terminal. Do not enlarge, raise, animate, or turn the X into an architectural emblem.

name: ThemeControls
purpose: Let visitors explicitly select light, dark, or system color theme.
states: light selected; dark selected; system selected
keyboard_behavior: Tab reaches each radio-like button; Space or Enter selects the focused choice.
accessible_name: Radiogroup named Color theme; every option has an explicit accessible label.
focus_behavior: Each native button receives visible focus; selection is not communicated by color alone.
responsive_behavior: Remains compact; optional labels may appear in larger contexts.
localization_behavior: Labels can expand; stored values stay light, dark, system.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; theme persistence, contrast, and hydration verification pending.

name: CommandPalette
purpose: Provide fast keyboard and pointer navigation to the kingXford & Co mission and major public routes.
content_contract: Trigger, search input, six destination records including Mission, R&D / Lab, Work, Media, About, and Contact; active result; empty state; close control.
states: closed; open; querying; active option; no result; dismissed
keyboard_behavior: Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles; ArrowUp/ArrowDown changes result; Enter navigates; Escape or close dismisses.
accessible_name: Trigger is Open site command menu; dialog title and search label are explicit; results expose listbox semantics.
focus_behavior: Focus moves to search on open; native modal dialog contains focus; close returns through native dialog behavior.
responsive_behavior: Panel fits compact viewport and uses the same command data.
localization_behavior: Search covers mission, intelligence, R&D, responsible AI, sustainable abundance, complex problems, projects, Media, and company capabilities.
data_dependencies: Next router and internal route list.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; mission and Media queries, keyboard sequence, and focus-return verification pending.
notes: Do not mount more than one instance because element IDs are stable.

name: ScrollProgress
purpose: Show non-essential reading progress without adding spoken noise.
responsive_behavior: Fixed visual bar scales to viewport width.
data_dependencies: Document scroll position and motion preference.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; performance and reduced-motion verification pending.
notes: Must remain supplementary; no content or control depends on it.

name: LoomCanvas
purpose: Create a decorative responsive kingXford & Co connection field behind the mission chapter.
content_contract: CSS color variables and containing dimensions.
variants: fine-pointer animated; coarse-pointer still; reduced-motion still; offscreen paused
keyboard_behavior: Not interactive; pointer movement only decorates.
accessible_name: Canvas must remain decorative and outside the accessibility tree through its parent treatment.
responsive_behavior: ResizeObserver resizes with the hero; DPR is capped at 1.75.
data_dependencies: CSS custom properties; pointer, visibility, motion, and intersection media/state.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; battery, contrast, and resize verification pending.
notes: Animation pauses offscreen and when the document is hidden.

name: KingxfordCinematic
purpose: Lead with the kingXford & Co mission through a long native-scroll narrative about intelligence, R&D, responsible AI, aligned contribution, and sustainable abundance.
content_contract: Six editorial chapters; authentic public-product captures and source-recorded prototype, planning, laboratory, studio, and architecture photographs; mission, R&D, delivery-world, and collaboration links.
states: mission; intelligence; R&D; responsible AI; & Co; abundant future; reduced-motion
keyboard_behavior: All links are native anchors or Next links; scrolling remains native and interruptible.
accessible_name: Section labels the kingXford & Co mission; every meaningful reduced-motion image retains purpose-based alt text that distinguishes authentic product evidence from contextual documentary photography.
focus_behavior: Child links receive the global visible focus style; decorative layers never receive focus.
responsive_behavior: The 760svh sequence becomes a stacked static composition when reduced motion is requested; proof cards and captions scale at compact widths.
localization_behavior: English chapter copy must be reviewed if localized; content remains understandable without timed playback.
data_dependencies: KingxfordLogo; LoomCanvas; Motion values; local authentic product-capture WebPs; local source-recorded documentary WebPs.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; active-image source audit, six-checkpoint scroll, responsive crops, documentary context, and reduced-motion rendered verification pending.
notes: All active plates are authentic public-product captures or licensed documentary sources. The & Co chapter represents aligned contributors without naming pictured documentary subjects as kingXford & Co people; no generated imagery, short looping video, audio, or scroll-jacking dependency.

name: Reveal
purpose: Progressively reveal server-rendered content without hiding it when JavaScript is unavailable.
content_contract: One child tree plus optional className, delay, distance, and viewport amount.
accessible_name: Not applicable; wrapper does not change child semantics.
focus_behavior: Does not alter child focus behavior.
responsive_behavior: Distance and threshold can be tuned by caller; content remains in normal flow.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; no-JavaScript and reduced-motion verification pending.
notes: Initial content remains rendered because initial is false.

name: ProjectLens
purpose: Search and filter the project archive while announcing result count.
content_contract: Categories, active category, query, result count, and change/reset callbacks.
states: default; typing; selected; clearable; reset available
keyboard_behavior: Tab reaches search, clear, category buttons, and reset; native buttons use Space/Enter.
accessible_name: Search has a programmatic label; category group and count live region are named.
focus_behavior: Every native control receives visible focus; pressed state is exposed with aria-pressed.
responsive_behavior: Search/count stack and category row can scroll or wrap at compact widths.
localization_behavior: Category labels and placeholder require expansion testing.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; query, no-match, live-region, and mobile overflow verification pending.
notes: Result count uses polite live announcement.

name: WorkGrid
purpose: Filter, sequence, and render the four published project cards.
content_contract: Published project items only, plus optional featured-only flag, limit, lens visibility, and className. Unreleased archive records never enter this component's public data flow.
keyboard_behavior: Keyboard behavior is delegated to ProjectLens and ProjectCard native controls.
accessible_name: List region communicates busy state and changes politely; empty-state recovery has clear text.
focus_behavior: Child controls retain visible focus during filtering.
responsive_behavior: Cards reflow without changing reading order; layout animation is removed for reduced motion.
localization_behavior: Search normalization is locale-aware; full localization requires translated project data.
data_dependencies: The published-only projects export from src/data/projects.ts.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; filter combinations, archive-exclusion, no-match, and animation verification pending.
notes: The public collection contains Veridanth, Psyche Atlas, GrandMaster, and Value-M. CCAI Global, Aceplore, Nkosuo, and Elkings College remain archive-only and do not enter navigation, search, related work, metadata, sitemaps, or generated routes.

name: ProjectCard
purpose: Provide a complete, scannable link to one case study.
content_contract: Published project title, eyebrow, summary, year, categories, authentic cover, alt text, and slug; optional index, priority, and featured state.
keyboard_behavior: The full card is one native link; Enter activates.
accessible_name: The case-study link identifies a published project; image alt text describes authentic product evidence or contextual documentary photography.
focus_behavior: One focusable card link receives the global visible focus style.
responsive_behavior: Image sizes and layout adapt to featured and standard contexts.
localization_behavior: Long project names and category expansion require stress testing.
data_dependencies: One record from the published-only Project collection.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; archive-exclusion, broken-image, long-title, focus, and mobile tests pending.
notes: Only Veridanth, Psyche Atlas, GrandMaster, and Value-M reach this public component. Unreleased records remain outside the rendered data flow.

name: MediaPostCard
purpose: Provide a complete, scannable link from the kingXford & Co Media index to one article.
content_contract: Licensed documentary context cover and visible contextual caption; format; publication date; reading time; title; description; topics; article link.
states: default; hover; focus-visible; image loading; broken image
keyboard_behavior: The full card is one native link; Enter activates.
accessible_name: Link names the article; cover alt text describes the documentary subject; figcaption states that the image is licensed and contextual rather than kingXford & Co project evidence; topics are labelled.
focus_behavior: One focusable card link receives the global visible focus style.
responsive_behavior: Featured media remains full-width and reflows without changing reading order.
localization_behavior: Dates, reading labels, topics, and article titles require expansion testing for future localization.
data_dependencies: MediaPost records from src/data/media.ts and source-recorded documentary assets.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; rendered crop, contextual caption, broken-image, focus, and mobile tests pending.
notes: Sustainable Abundance uses the Jonathan Borba process photograph; the AI-era article uses the neutral GN Group prototype-documentary path. Neither is evidence of a kingXford & Co project, team, facility, or outcome.

name: MediaArticlePage
purpose: Publish complete kingXford & Co long-form Media articles with institutional research notes, contextual documentary imagery, article-specific action plans where appropriate, and an optional narrated edition.
content_contract: Article metadata and schema; source-recorded contextual cover and caption; table of contents; introduction; sections and principles; optional action plan; closing; institutional sources; optional AudioEdition; next-post navigation.
variants: article without action plan; article with action plan; article with approved audio; not found
sizes: compact reading column; intermediate rail; wide article
states: default; section anchors; external source focus; audio absent; optional audio ready; optional audio failure; not found
keyboard_behavior: All navigation and source links are native; the optional native audio element is keyboard operable only when an approved audio record exists.
accessible_name: Article, on-this-page navigation, source list, and optional player have explicit labels; complete readable text remains available with or without audio.
focus_behavior: Logical document focus order; global visible focus; no player or dead audio control renders when audio data is absent.
responsive_behavior: The rail collapses around the reading flow on compact screens; cover and optional plan stages reflow; line length remains bounded.
localization_behavior: Long headings, citation titles, dates, topics, and future transcript or chapter labels require expansion testing.
data_dependencies: MediaPost records from src/data/media.ts; source-recorded documentary assets; optional audio record; creative/narration-policy.md.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; 23-route build, both article routes, anchors, source links, contextual captions, no-audio state, responsive reading, metadata, schema, and accessibility verification pending.
notes: Sustainable Abundance for All must preserve source years, units, ranges, projections, and caveats. Documentary covers remain contextual; no narration asset ships in this release.

name: ProjectBriefBuilder
purpose: Help a visitor structure a complex problem or ambitious project before institutional engagement.
content_contract: Seven browser-local fields: problem, affected people and institutions, evidence and unknowns, desired future, constraints, available investment, and time horizon; copy and plain-text download actions; privacy note.
variants: empty; partially completed; completed; copied; downloaded; copy unavailable
sizes: compact single column; two-column medium and wide
states: idle; editing; copy success; copy failure; download success
keyboard_behavior: Tab reaches each native field and action; Space or Enter activates buttons; native select supports keyboard selection.
accessible_name: Section heading, labels, helper text, and action names are explicit; status is announced politely.
focus_behavior: Every field and button receives a visible focus treatment; status changes do not move focus.
responsive_behavior: Fields use one column on compact screens and two columns from 760px; important rows span the full width.
localization_behavior: Long prompts and option labels require expansion testing.
data_dependencies: Component-local React state, Clipboard API, Blob and object URL; no network or storage dependency.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; keyboard, clipboard-failure, download, privacy, and mobile tests pending.
notes: The worksheet runs locally and must not submit, store, transmit, or log visitor content.

name: SustainableAbundanceEvidence
purpose: Turn the Sustainable Abundance briefing's official evidence into accessible visual comparisons without inventing a composite total.
content_contract: Foundational-capability metric dashboard; research-density bars; renewable-capacity stack; data-centre electricity comparison; evidence-register table; source links and interpretation notes; original Sustainable Abundance Design Loop.
states: default; external source focus; compact table scroll; source unavailable
keyboard_behavior: All source links are native anchors; the horizontally scrollable table wrapper can receive focus; figures are not interactive.
accessible_name: Every visual has direct values, units, an aria label or semantic table, and a visible caption that states its interpretation boundary.
focus_behavior: Source links receive visible focus; non-interactive charts do not receive focus; the compact table wrapper is focusable for keyboard scrolling.
responsive_behavior: Two-column metric and chart layouts collapse to one column; the table preserves semantic rows and scrolls horizontally without hiding data.
localization_behavior: English labels, source titles, units, and large values require expansion testing.
data_dependencies: Official source URLs and fixed values in SustainableAbundanceEvidence; article source register in src/data/media.ts.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; value/source reconciliation, mobile table, keyboard, contrast, zoom, and production-link verification pending.
notes: Never add overlapping access-gap populations. Preserve uncertainty intervals, source years, units, definitions, and the distinction between observed estimates and scenarios. The original framework is not a validated causal model, universal index, or forecast.
